blocks.text: For those of us who lived through the vibrant, volatile explosion of turn-of-the-millennium alternative rock, few tracks capture the raw emotional weight and sonic evolution of the era quite like Taproot’s breakout anthem, “Poem.” Released in the autumn of 2002 as the lead single from their landmark sophomore album, ‘Welcome,’ the track remains a masterclass in balancing bruising nu-metal riffs with hauntingly accessible melodic sensibilities. A Departure from Formulaic Angst While early 2000s mainstream airwaves were heavily saturated with testosterone-fueled bravado and cookie-cutter angst, the Ann Arbor, Michigan quartet pivoted toward a path of raw, unhealed vulnerability—a creative gamble that culminates beautifully in “Poem.” […]...
